page_title: AUG 1-0 HEI | Augsburg v Heidenheim 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' What was Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+3' The yellow card goes to Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' That's the end of the game for Mert Komur, who is replaced by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg).
87' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan Schoppner and he is replaced by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).
87' Today's match ends for Hennes Behrens who will be replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
86' The attendance for today's match is 30107.
84' Mert Komur (Augsburg) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
83' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Diant Ramaj.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Julian Niehues walks off the pitch to be replaced by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim).
80' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Diant Ramaj.
80' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
80' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
79' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
78' This shall not pass! Mert Komur (Augsburg) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Augsburg get a corner.
77' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
76' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
73' Manuel Baum decides to make a substitution. Robin Fellhauer will be replaced by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg).
73' Substitution. Kristijan Jakic leaves the pitch and is replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
72' Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
71' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).

70' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
69' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
67' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

65' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top left corner, but Finn Dahmen was alert and the score remains the same.
64' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) replaces Stefan Schimmer.
64' Substitution. Christian Conteh will be replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
63' The Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Felix Zwayer rules it out for a foul.
61' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
61' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

60' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Here is a change. Michael Gregoritsch is going off and Manuel Baum gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg).
59' It will be a substitution. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Anton Kade walks off.
57' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
53' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
52' A clumsy foul by Mert Komur (Augsburg) and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle.
50' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
50' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
47' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' A rebound falls at the feet of Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the left post.
44' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

38' What a poor attempt! Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
37' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
34' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.
33' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Felix Zwayer signals a foul.
32' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
25' That was close by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
22' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.

20' Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Heidenheim.

17' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Diant Ramaj, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
16' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
14' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
14' The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
13' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Heidenheim earn a corner.
13' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.

12' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Some great controlled play and passing from Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
8' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
6' Mert Komur (Augsburg) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
4' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer was nominated as the referee for this game.
